about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Barramundi with Lemon Caper Butter and Greens
recipes.summary: Pan-seared farmed barramundi fillets with a quick lemon and caper butter, green beans and potatoes.
steps: Boil the potato for 15 minutes until tender, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes, then drain.
Pat the fish dry, season with the salt and sear in the oil, skin side down, for 4 minutes. Turn and cook for 2 minutes more.
Melt the butter in the pan, add the capers, lemon zest and juice and parsley, and spoon over the fish with the potato and beans.
notes: Barramundi is widely farmed in Australia, a more sustainable pick.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Tinned Salmon and Tomato Spaghetti with Lemon Crumbs
recipes.summary: A pantry pasta using tinned salmon, tomato, garlic and lemon crumbs.
steps: Boil the spaghetti for 10 minutes until al dente and keep half a cup of the water.
Fry the garlic and chilli in half the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes. Break in the salmon and warm for 2 minutes.
Toast the breadcrumbs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes. Toss the pasta with the sauce, a splash of pasta water and the lemon zest and parsley, and top with the crumbs.
notes: Contains fish and gluten. Tinned salmon is a convenient pantry fish.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Baked Snapper with Herb Crust and Crunchy Slaw
recipes.summary: Snapper fillets under a golden herb crumb with a fresh cabbage and apple slaw.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and line a tray. Mix the breadcrumbs, parsley, zest and oil.
Brush the fillets with mustard, press on the crumbs and bake for 12 minutes until golden and the fish flakes.
Toss the cabbage, apple, carrot, mayonnaise and vinegar and serve alongside.
notes: Contains fish, egg and gluten.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Lemony Prawn Linguine with Zucchini Ribbons and Parsley
recipes.summary: Quick prawn linguine with zucchini, garlic, chilli and lemon.
steps: Boil the linguine for 10 minutes until al dente and keep half a cup of the water.
Fry the garlic and chilli in the oil for 1 minute, add the zucchini for 3 minutes, then the prawns for 3 minutes until pink and curled.
Toss the pasta through with the lemon, parsley, salt and a splash of pasta water.
notes: Contains shellfish and gluten.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Salmon and Sweet Potato Fishcakes with Yoghurt Dip
recipes.summary: Pan-fried fishcakes from tinned salmon and mash, with a lime yoghurt dip and salad.
steps: Boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until soft, drain and mash.
Mix the mash with the salmon, spring onion, zest, half the breadcrumbs and the egg, shape into 8 patties and coat with the remaining crumbs.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side until golden and hot through. Stir the yoghurt and lime and serve with the leaves.
notes: Contains fish, egg, dairy and gluten. Patties freeze well before cooking.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Mussels in White Wine and Garlic with Crusty Bread
recipes.summary: Farmed mussels steamed open in garlic, wine and parsley, with bread for the broth.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil and butter for 4 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute, then pour in the wine.
Add the mussels, cover and steam for 5 minutes, shaking the pot, until the shells open.
Discard any that stay closed, scatter over the parsley and serve with the bread.
notes: Farmed mussels are among the most sustainable seafood choices.
Food safety: discard mussels that are open before cooking and will not close when tapped, and any that stay shut after steaming; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Thai-Style Fish Parcels with Lime and Ginger
recipes.summary: Firm white fish steamed in baking paper with lime, ginger, lemongrass and chilli, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet. Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Place each fillet on a sheet of baking paper with bok choy, ginger, lemongrass, chilli, lime and fish sauce, and fold into sealed parcels.
Bake for 14 minutes until the fish flakes, then open and scatter over coriander. Serve with the rice.
notes: Contains fish. Use any sustainable firm white fish such as flathead or barramundi.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon and Potato Salad with Horseradish Dressing
recipes.summary: A warm dinner salad of new potatoes, smoked salmon, beans and a creamy horseradish dressing.
steps: Boil the potato for 12 minutes, adding the beans for 3 minutes and the eggs for 8 minutes in a separate pot. Drain, peel and quarter the eggs.
Stir the sour cream, horseradish, dill and lemon juice together.
Toss the warm potato, beans, salmon and onion with the dressing and top with the egg, until everything is evenly coated.
notes: Contains fish, egg and dairy.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Calamari with Chilli, Lemon and Rocket
recipes.summary: Quickly seared calamari tossed with chilli and lemon over rocket and white beans.
steps: Toss the calamari with the paprika and salt.
Heat the oil in a very hot pan and sear the calamari in two batches for 90 seconds each until just opaque. Add the garlic and chilli for the last 30 seconds.
Toss the beans, rocket, lemon and calamari together and serve at once.
notes: Calamari turns tough if overcooked, so work in batches.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Chicken Liver with Caramelised Onions and Mash
recipes.summary: A gentle introduction to offal: chicken liver, sweet onions and creamy mash.
steps: Boil the potato for 15 minutes, drain and mash with half the butter, the milk and half the salt.
Cook the onions in the remaining butter over low heat for 20 minutes until deep golden, add the vinegar and set aside.
Pat the liver dry and dust with flour. Fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until browned and no pink remains. Add the stock to the pan for 2 minutes and serve over the mash with the onions.
notes: Liver is rich in vitamin A, so enjoy it occasionally rather than daily, and avoid it in pregnancy.
Food safety: cook liver until no pink remains inside and it reaches 75°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Chicken Liver Ragu with Sage and Mushrooms
recipes.summary: A rich, silky ragu with chicken livers blended through mushrooms and tomato, served over pappardelle.
steps: Cook the onion and mushroom in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, add the garlic and sage for 1 minute.
Add the livers and cook for 4 minutes, stirring, until browned all over. Pour in the wine, then the tomatoes, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Boil the pappardelle for 9 minutes and toss through the ragu with the parmesan.
notes: Contains gluten, dairy and egg. Chicken liver is rich in vitamin A, so avoid it in pregnancy.
Food safety: cook the liver until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Braised Beef Cheek with Red Wine and Creamy Polenta
recipes.summary: Slow-braised beef cheeks that fall apart, over soft polenta. A beginner step into nose-to-tail cooking.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Brown the cheeks in the oil in batches and set aside.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery for 6 minutes, add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute, then the wine and stock and bay leaf. Return the beef, cover and braise for 3 hours until tender.
Cook the polenta with 6 cups of water for 15 minutes, stirring, then stir in the butter and parmesan. Spoon the beef and sauce on top.
notes: Contains dairy. Cheek is a cheap cut that becomes tender with long, slow cooking.
Food safety: braise beef until very tender and above 75°C; cool leftovers quickly, refrigerate within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Oxtail and Butter Bean Stew with Smoked Paprika
recipes.summary: A deeply savoury stew of oxtail and butter beans, even better the next day.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Brown the oxtail in the oil in batches and set aside.
Soften the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, stock and bay leaf. Return the oxtail, cover and braise for 3 hours.
Add the beans and cook uncovered for 20 minutes. Skim off excess fat and scatter with parsley.
notes: Chill overnight so the fat sets and lifts off easily.
Food safety: braise until the meat falls from the bone; cool quickly, refrigerate within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Braised Beef Cheek Tacos with Green Salsa
recipes.summary: Tender braised beef cheek shredded into soft tortillas with green salsa and onion.
steps: Simmer the cheeks with the onion, garlic, bay leaf and salt in water for 2.5 hours until completely tender, then shred.
Blend the green tomato, jalapeno, half the coriander and lime into a salsa.
Sear the shredded beef in a hot pan for 3 minutes until crisp at the edges and serve in warm tortillas with salsa, diced onion and remaining coriander.
notes: Beef cheek is a budget cut that needs only time.
Food safety: simmer until completely tender and well above 75°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Crispy Tofu and Greens with Black Bean Sauce
recipes.summary: Golden tofu cubes and gai lan in a savoury fermented black bean sauce over rice.
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet until tender.
Toss the tofu in cornflour and fry in 2 tablespoons of the oil for 8 minutes until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Fry the garlic, ginger and black bean sauce in the remaining oil for 1 minute, add the greens, soy sauce, sugar and 1/4 cup of water for 3 minutes, then toss in the tofu.
notes: Contains soy and gluten. Use tamari and a gluten-free black bean sauce for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Crumbed Tofu Cutlets with Japanese Vegetable Curry
recipes.summary: Crumbed tofu cutlets with a mild Japanese-style vegetable curry sauce and rice.

items: 600g firm tofu, pressed and sliced into 8 slabs

steps: Cook the rice. Soften the onion, carrot and potato in a little oil for 5 minutes, stir in the curry powder and 2 tablespoons of flour for 1 minute, then add the stock, soy and maple syrup and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Dip the tofu in the flour, then the milk, then the panko.
Shallow-fry the tofu in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and serve with the sauce and rice.
notes: Contains soy, gluten and milk. Use a plant milk of your choice.

recipes.title: Smoky Tofu and Peanut Sambal Bowls
recipes.summary: Pan-fried tofu with a quick chilli peanut sambal, cucumber, greens and rice.
steps: Cook the rice, steaming the beans on top for the last 4 minutes.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 4 minutes each side until golden, adding the soy sauce and paprika for the last minute.
Whisk the peanut butter, sweet chilli, lime and 3 tablespoons of warm water into a sambal. Serve over the rice, tofu, beans and cucumber.
notes: Contains soy, peanuts and gluten. Check the soy sauce label if avoiding gluten.

recipes.title: Tofu and Capsicum Skewers with Coconut Rice
recipes.summary: Marinated tofu and vegetable skewers grilled with Thai red curry paste, served with coconut rice.
steps: Mix the curry paste, 2 tablespoons coconut milk and soy sauce and toss the tofu in it. Thread onto skewers with the capsicum and onion.
Cook the rice with the cup of coconut milk and 1 cup of water for 15 minutes.
Brush the skewers with oil and grill for 4 minutes each side until charred. Serve with the rice and lime.
notes: Contains soy, gluten and shellfish. Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes first. Check the curry paste for shrimp paste if you need it vegan.

recipes.title: Harissa Chickpea and Eggplant Tagine
recipes.summary: A fragrant vegetable tagine of chickpeas, eggplant and apricot, served over couscous.
steps: Soften the onion and eggplant in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, harissa and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, apricot and stock, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the eggplant is soft.
Cover the couscous with 1.5 cups of boiling water for 5 minutes, fluff, and serve under the tagine with the coriander.
notes: Contains gluten (couscous). Serve over rice for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lentil and Spinach Dal with Garlic Tarka
recipes.summary: Creamy red lentil dal finished with a sizzling garlic and cumin tarka, served with rice.
steps: Simmer the lentils, onion, ginger, turmeric, salt and 5 cups of water for 25 minutes until soft, stirring occasionally. Stir in the spinach to wilt. Cook the rice separately.
Heat the ghee in a small pan and fry the garlic, cumin seeds and chilli for 1 minute until golden.
Pour the tarka over the dal and serve with the rice.
notes: Contains dairy (ghee). Use oil for vegan.

recipes.title: Pumpkin and Chickpea Stew with Ras el Hanout and Preserved Lemon
recipes.summary: Chickpeas and pumpkin simmered with ras el hanout, tomato and preserved lemon.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic and spice for 1 minute.
Add the pumpkin, tomatoes, chickpeas and stock and simmer for 25 minutes until the pumpkin is soft.
Stir through the preserved lemon and serve with the coriander and yoghurt.
notes: Contains dairy. Skip the yoghurt for vegan. Serve with flatbread or couscous.

recipes.title: Feijoada-Style Black Bean Stew with Rice and Orange
recipes.summary: A smoky vegetarian black bean stew in the style of feijoada, with rice, greens and orange.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, paprika, cumin and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the beans, stock and bay leaf, simmer for 30 minutes until thick, then mash a quarter of the beans to thicken.
Stir in the silverbeet for 3 minutes. Cook the rice and serve with the stew and orange.
notes: Vegan and gluten free. Traditional feijoada includes pork; this version is plant-based.
